findings.message: The boundary contract requires a select commit reachable from HEAD, but clutch/merge.py and clutch/git.py squash the ticket branch, so a normally merged generate ticket cannot satisfy that condition.
findings.paved_road: Revise the contract to use durable merge provenance that records the select commit, and include its owning implementation and tests in scope, or first change merge behavior to preserve the commit.
